title: Downstream JWT Payload
description: The claims structure of the minted JWT returned by POST /exchange. This is the payload that the downstream service (e.g. Qlik Sense JWT virtual proxy) will validate.

userid.description: Mapped from the incoming JWT's sub claim. Identifies the user to the downstream service.

userdirectory.description: Downstream user directory name. Only present when configured server-side.

name.description: Carried from the incoming JWT's name claim if present.

email.description: Carried from the incoming JWT's email claim if present.

groups.description: Filtered group memberships — only groups present in the server-side whitelist.

aud.description: Audience — must match the downstream service's expected audience.

exp.description: Expiry time as Unix timestamp. Capped at the incoming JWT's exp.
